title: The Dark Truth About Self-Compassion Beats Self-Criticism
hook: This one diagram explains your whole mood.
description:
Self-Compassion Beats Self-Criticism — explained in 60 seconds.

Self-criticism predicts procrastination and quitting. Self-compassion predicts trying again.

What actually happens in your brain: Harsh self-talk triggers threat mode — fight/flight about yourself. Threat mode is terrible for learning.

Try it today: Talk to yourself like you'd talk to a friend who failed. Not softness — strategy.
